stem: Which of the following best supports the idea that finishing the Ironman Triathlon was a remarkable feat for Mr. Evolta?

options.label: F
options.text: It normally takes less than 13 hours for a human to complete the competition.

options.label: G
options.text: Mr. Evolta is only about one-tenth the height of the average human.

options.label: H
options.text: Each race in the event was held in Hawaii.

options.label: J
options.text: Mr. Evolta needed more time to finish the competition than a human would.
